relationships.subject: 5-hydroxyconiferaldehyde
relationships.evidence_quote: by suppressing the nuclear factor-κB (NF-κB) and mitogen-activated protein kinase (MAPK)/activator protein-1 (AP-1) signaling pathways in LPS-induced RAW 264.7 macrophages

relationships.subject: 5-hydroxyconiferaldehyde
relationships.evidence_quote: 5-HCA suppressed the generation of reactive oxygen species (ROS) triggered by LPS by enhancing heme oxygenase-1 (HO-1) expression via nuclear translocation of nuclear factor erythroid 2-related factor 2 (Nrf2)

relationships.subject: 5-hydroxyconiferaldehyde
relationships.evidence_quote: 5-HCA considerably impeded nitric oxide (NO) and PGE<sub>2</sub> production as well as inducible nitric oxide synthase (iNOS), cyclooxygenase-2 (COX-2)

key_findings: 5-HCA suppresses NF-kB and MAPK/AP-1 and enhances Nrf2/HO-1 in LPS macrophages and reduces carrageenan hyperalgesia in rats.
